section.5: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

5.name_native: Establishing the Prayer and the Sunnah Regarding Them

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Abu Ja’d Ad-Damri who was a Companion said that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:“Whoever abandons Friday (prayer) three times, neglecting it, a seal will be placed over his heart.”
